summary_1line: Yayati curses sons who refuse his old age, Puru accepts it, Yayati enjoys youth for a millennium, then renounces desire and restores Puru’s youth and kingdom.

image_candidates.scene_text: The aged king Yayati places his hand on the humble Puru as mystical power transfers the king’s decrepitude into the young prince’s body.
Rejuvenated Yayati revels in celestial gardens with the apsara Viswachi amid the splendor of Indra’s paradise.
After a thousand years, the grey and weary Yayati returns the youth to Puru before the royal court, preparing to renounce worldly life.
